item.title: Oakland sports calendar: A celebration for Alysa Liu; Roots and Falcons season openers
item.description: Oakland sports calendar: A celebration for Alysa Liu; Roots and Falcons season openers Other events include Oakland Ballers open tryouts, the Oakland 68s Fans Fest, and championship matches for Oakland high school soccer and basketball.

item.title: OUSD board approves 421 staff layoffs
item.description: OUSD board approves 421 staff layoffs Less than a year out of state receivership and facing the threat of a strike, the Oakland school district’s finances are stretched thin.

item.title: Wilson Riles Jr., renowned Oakland activist and official, recovering from stroke
item.description: Wilson Riles Jr., renowned Oakland activist and official, recovering from stroke Riles, a police commissioner and former council member, has worked for decades connecting global and local social justice causes. His family is fundraising to support his recovery.

item.title: Oakland Tech’s Shayna Ward makes a run for a state wrestling title
item.description: Oakland Tech’s Shayna Ward makes a run for a state wrestling title Legendary coach Ashlee Sherman has never won a California championship. The star senior from Tech might be the 79-year-old's last best chance.

item.title: What’s happening in Oakland City Hall, on the podcast
item.description: What’s happening in Oakland City Hall, on the podcast Catch up on Oakland news while walking the dog or cooking dinner with Oaklandside 510.

item.title: Oakland teachers avert strike, reach tentative deal with OUSD
item.description: Oakland teachers avert strike, reach tentative deal with OUSD The union won an 11% pay raise over two years, with 13% for senior teachers. The tentative agreement now awaits approval by the school board and the union’s members — and review by the county superintendent.

item.title: Embargo of Israeli military cargo gains Oakland Mayor Lee’s support
item.description: Embargo of Israeli military cargo gains Oakland Mayor Lee’s support Barbara Lee, known for her stand in Congress against the “War on Terror,” has backed a campaign to halt shipments of military equipment destined for Israel from passing through Oakland's airport.

item.title: Photos: Oakland celebrates 100 years of Black History Month
item.description: Photos: Oakland celebrates 100 years of Black History Month Mayor Barbara Lee, Kevin Jenkins, and other Black elected officials were on hand for a bash at the Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts with performances, awards, and food from local chefs.

item.title: A museum dedicated to Oakland’s trash
item.description: A museum dedicated to Oakland’s trash The Trash Falcons, who clean up around Lake Merritt, have two exhibits up at the Junior Center of Art and Science that turn their gleanings into art.

item.title: US strikes Iran; protests erupt worldwide
item.description: US strikes Iran; protests erupt worldwide Rep. Lateefah Simon said the attacks 'demonstrate once again President Trump’s callous disregard for the rule of law.' Protests are planned for today in Oakland and San Francisco.
